parallels.note: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

translations.web: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.
translations.bsb: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve Him.
translations.kjv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
translations.asv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her; and she arose, and ministered unto him.
